results.content:
Title: AmpUp: Open-source AI chat for your GTM stack - own the base layer | Product Hunt
# AmpUp. ## Open-source AI chat for your GTM stack - own the base layer. A chat agent that lives on top of your CRM, calls, and tools over MCP. The base layer is open source and free, so clone it and own it today. Bring in the hosted layers (memory, analytics, coaching) the moment they stop being your job. - Try it: https://chat.ampup.ai - Clone it (OSS): https://github.com/A79-ai/gtm-agentic-chat. No reviews yetBe the first to leave a review for AmpUp. Every prospect now asks us the same thing: "Why can't I just build this myself with ChatGPT?". Our honest answer: you can build the easy part. A chat over your data with a few MCP tools is a weekend, not a roadmap. So we stopped pretending it was a moat and open-sourced it. 👉 gtm-chat is the free base layer. Clone it, point it at your stack, own it forever. Here's the thing the demo never shows. - 2025 is agents + MCP → that's where ChatGPT lands you (and where the OSS repo lands you, today). - 2026 is memory, analytics, and coaching → agents act, then forget. The hard part is everything that stays alive above the chat:. Not an API call, a job that never ships once. 🧠 Memory: agents that remember the deal, the rep, the call. 📊 Analytics & coaching: AI roleplay on real calls. Voice-AI deep tech your sales team should never have to run. So build-vs-buy is a false binary. It's build and buy, sequenced: own the open-source base now, let us carry the compounding layers as they arrive. Start free on GitHub. Try the hosted brain at chat.ampup.ai. I like the build-and-buy framing. Open-sourcing the base chat layer feels honest because many teams can build a simple MCP chat, but maintaining CRM integrations, memory, analytics, and coaching over time is where the real complexity starts. The enterprise offering of Ampup essentially handles schema unification and de-duping for you. So a meeting event that comes via google-cal, salesforce and gong collapse into a single entity. Happy to chat more if you are interested in something like this.

The SDK makes it super easy to spin up custom AI agents, and the integration with MCP servers means deployment is seamless. What I love most is how much time it saves — from testing locally to pushing updates in the cloud, everything just works. The fact that it’s open-source and trusted by top teams at NASA, Cisco, and NVIDIA gives me confidence in its stability and scalability. If you’re building AI agents and want a reliable, well-supported platform, MCP-Use is a must-try.
